passages.provision_quote: It is the intent of the Legislature that all state agencies aim to achieve net-zero emissions of greenhouse gases resulting from their operations, including scope 1 and scope 2 emissions, no later than January 1, 2035, or as soon as feasible thereafter.
passages.note: An intent clause plus inventory, plan and report duties on the Department of General Services, all qualified by "to the extent feasible".

rows.reasoning: Becker authored SB 1203 (2021-2022), which declares "the intent of the Legislature that all state agencies aim to achieve net-zero emissions" by January 1, 2035 and orders the Department of General Services to publish an inventory, a plan and progress reports. An aim with a date is not the "mandates and firm deadlines" of "Require a shift to clean energy", and a net-zero emissions target names no energy source, so it can be met without expanding clean energy; the plan and reporting duties are a study directive whose stated goal shows only a side. The appropriation-contingent "required actions and investments" do not appropriate money, so "Fund clean energy with major subsidies, tax credits, and public investment" is not evidenced either.
